headline: PTC (PTC) Launches Onshape Labs To Bring AI Into Product Development
summary: PTC (NasdaqGS:PTC) has launched Onshape Labs within its cloud-native CAD and PDM platform. The initiative introduces an early-access program for customers to test AI-driven tools inside live product development workflows. Initial capabilities include AI Quick Render, automation agents, and AI-powered drawing validation. PTC plans a broader rollout of Onshape Labs features to its customer base soon.
